plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly productivity coaching: daily planning (/today, /energy), end-of-day capture (/checkin), weekly scheduling (/plan-week) and review (/weekly), life-direction reviews (/review), goal-to-project alignment (/align), project lifecycle (/intake, /breakdown, /reentry, /sunset), idea capture (/spark), brain dump (/dump), task triage (/triage), decision journaling (/decide), and pattern analysis (momentum, overdue-rescue) with adaptive tone calibration

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Format-aware atomic commits for git and jj (Jujutsu). One skill covering commit, split, message review, and retrofitting edits into earlier commits (jj absorb / git fixup). Auto-detects VCS and commit message style from repo context. Includes PreToolUse hook that blocks destructive working-copy operations.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: A suite of conversational thinking tools — reflect (Socratic mirror, never recommends, always saves) and mull (thinking partner, probes AND contributes opinions, saves substantive sessions only).

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Software craftsmanship discipline skills: grill-with-docs (vocabulary grilling against per-repo CONTEXT.md glossaries), diagnose, prototype, tdd, improve-codebase-architecture, grok (stateful multi-session codebase comprehension with supersession-aware understanding records), zoom-out (adapted in part from mattpocock/skills, MIT), infra-review (architecture/security review of Terraform+Atlantis PRs), quiz-me (opt-in active-recall comprehension check after a code explanation), interrogate-model (holistic representability review of a domain model — the legitimate scenarios and personas it cannot express), and design-by-stories (design an artifact's shape — schema, template, data model, config — by modeling its actors and user stories first, then deriving the shape from the stories). Composes with spec-flow and ndr plugins.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Dialectical decision analysis: dispatch parallel advocate agents to research opposing perspectives, optionally fact-check claims, challenge the consensus with devil's advocacy, and independently synthesize a verdict. Three modes (Quick/Standard/Deep) control pipeline depth. Not for factual lookups or simple preferences.

plugins.name: feedback
plugins.description: A two-sided loop for improving Claude Code plugins from test sessions. The 'session' skill (tester side) turns the current transcript into a copy-pasteable report grading the plugins exercised; the 'triage' skill (author side) aggregates many reports into a prioritized action plan, routing each finding to a concrete fix. Both share one report-format contract.

plugins.name: langfuse
plugins.description: The Langfuse x Claude Code Observability Plugin

plugins.name: librarian
plugins.description: Curates, catalogs, retrieves, and maintains your library of notes and knowledge in an Obsidian vault. Workflow-shaped (Capture / Process / Retrieve / Maintain) and agent-mediated (skills draft, agents execute). 16 skills + 4 agents + 5 references, coupled to the vault conventions in ~/Loose Ends/.claude/rules/{wiki.md,catalog.md} and the Templater templates in ~/Loose Ends/Templates/.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear workflow conventions for a small two-person team. Owns ticket creation defaults (including assignee), status flow semantics, label set, title shape, collaboration conventions, and MCP call patterns. Composes with spec-flow (which uses Linear as a contract host but defers to this plugin for the conventions). Includes a doctor skill for workspace setup validation.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: PM helpers for team Linear workflows. Skills for the weekly grooming loop (per-person WIP), plan-to-tickets breakdown (assignee-aware), and end-of-cycle retro notes (attribution + Linear-first output). Composes with the linear plugin; ndr and librarian integrations are optional externals.

plugins.name: provenance
plugins.description: Marketplace upkeep for borrowed work. Keeps adapted skills honest against their upstream sources: compares an adapted skill to its pinned upstream, flags behavioral drift and fabricated attributions, and refreshes the reviewed commit SHA. Houses upstream-review.

plugins.name: shake-tune
plugins.description: Interpret Klippain Shake Tune results for 3D printers: diagnose issues from PNG graphs, explain findings, recommend fixes, and track results over time. Supports belt comparison, input shaper, vibration profile, axes map, and excitation tests.

plugins.name: spec-flow
plugins.description: Personal SDLC scaffolding for AI-assisted development. A lightweight, ephemeral 'contract' between user and AI drives each code change from captured idea to verified done; the durable layer (CLAUDE.md, ndr atoms, README) lives elsewhere. Lifecycle: capture -> draft -> implement -> close.

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: A stateful, multi-session teaching workspace routed into the Obsidian vault. The /teach skill grounds learning in the user's documented learning style and high-trust sources, builds a mission, resources, glossary, and learning records as vault notes under the topic's best-fit context, and keeps lessons + cheat sheets as self-contained HTML. Grounds in owned textbooks via DEVONthink when available and pins live-code citations to immutable refs. Requires an Obsidian vault (obsidian-cli); optionally surfaces owned textbooks from DEVONthink. Adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT, © 2026 Matt Pocock).
